name: How many animals
summary: TGG relays Game Informer's preview that the game has more than 170 animal species, native and invasive.
body: He relays The Guardian's preview that 62 of them are birds. Manatees, iguanas and macaque monkeys are named alongside alligators and flamingos, with rare and legendary animals to find.
These counts come from press previews as he reports them, not from Rockstar's own pages.

The Tampa Bay Times repeats the figure of 62 bird species and says its reporters found a dozen of them in two hours: whooping crane, wood stork, northern gannet, great egret, roseate spoonbill, herring and laughing gulls, Caspian tern, mottled duck, brown and American white pelicans and great blue heron.
Audubon Florida's executive director Julie Wraithmell told the paper the spoonbills and white pelicans were locally appropriate for Florida.
